description: Policy shared by every hub (renovate-config's default.json, go-tools' go-renovaterc): the timezone the schedule presets are evaluated in, the 7-day third-party release-age soak and the 1-day first-party one, the monthly window, vulnerability alerts (GitHub's and OSV's), automerge for linters, minor and digest updates, and hugoh/hk-config//renovate.json (how to read the hk pins). Hubs keep their ecosystem rules and groups on top of this.

packageRules.description: My own packages (actions, reusable workflows, spoons, ...) skip the 7-day third-party soak, which guards against supply-chain risk: 1 day catches a bad release. Hubs' own rules come after this one, so a more specific soak there (first-party core's 12 hours, hk-config's 7 days) still wins.
